require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'
require 'digest'

# Upload microservice for document management
# Each user has isolated storage; users can only access their own uploads

module Auth
  def self.extract_user_id(request)
    token = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']&.sub(/^Bearer /, '')
    return nil unless token
    # In production this would verify JWT; here we decode the payload
    payload = Base64.decode64(token.split('.')[1] || '')
    data = JSON.parse(payload) rescue nil
    data&.dig('sub')
  end
end

module Storage
  BASE_PATH = '/var/uploads'

  def self.user_dir(user_id)
    safe_id = user_id.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')
    File.join(BASE_PATH, safe_id)
  end

  def self.store_file(user_id, filename, content)
    dir = user_dir(user_id)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
    safe_name = sanitize_filename(filename)
    path = File.join(dir, safe_name)
    File.write(path, content)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(content)
  end

  def self.sanitize_filename(name)
    # Remove path traversal attempts
    basename = File.basename(name)
    basename.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
  end

  def self.list_files(user_id)
    dir = user_dir(user_id)
    return [] unless Dir.exist?(dir)
    Dir.entries(dir).reject { |f| f.start_with?('.') }
  end

  def self.get_file(user_id, file_id)
    dir = user_dir(user_id)
    path = File.join(dir, sanitize_filename(file_id))
    return nil unless File.exist?(path)
    File.read(path)
  end
end

module AccessControl
  # Shared file access registry
  @@shares = {}

  def self.grant_access(owner_id, file_id, target_user_id)
    key = share_key(owner_id, file_id)
    @@shares[key] ||= []
    @@shares[key] << target_user_id
  end

  def self.has_access?(requesting_user, owner_id, file_id)
    return true if requesting_user == owner_id
    key = share_key(owner_id, file_id)
    @@shares[key]&.include?(requesting_user) || false
  end

  def self.share_key(owner_id, file_id)
    # Create a unique key for the share registry
    "#{owner_id}:#{file_id}"
  end

  def self.resolve_owner(file_path)
    # Extract owner from the file path structure /var/uploads/<owner_id>/<filename>
    parts = file_path.sub(Storage::BASE_PATH + '/', '').split('/')
    parts.first
  end
end

class UploadService < Sinatra::Base
  before do
    @current_user = Auth.extract_user_id(request)
    unless @current_user || request.path_info == '/health'
      halt 401, JSON.generate({error: 'Unauthorized'})
    end
  end

  get '/health' do
    JSON.generate({status: 'ok'})
  end

  post '/upload' do
    file = params[:file]
    halt 400, JSON.generate({error: 'No file provided'}) unless file

    filename = file[:filename]
    content = file[:tempfile].read

    # Limit file size to 10MB
    halt 413, JSON.generate({error: 'File too large'}) if content.bytesize > 10_485_760

    checksum = Storage.store_file(@current_user, filename, content)
    JSON.generate({status: 'uploaded', checksum: checksum, filename: Storage.sanitize_filename(filename)})
  end

  get '/files' do
    files = Storage.list_files(@current_user)
    JSON.generate({files: files})
  end

  get '/files/:file_id' do
    file_id = params[:file_id]

    # Only serve files belonging to the current user
    content = Storage.get_file(@current_user, file_id)
    halt 404, JSON.generate({error: 'Not found'}) unless content
    content_type 'application/octet-stream'
    content
  end

  get '/shared/:owner_id/:file_id' do
    owner_id = params[:owner_id]
    file_id = params[:file_id]

    # Authorization check: verify the requesting user has been explicitly granted access
    unless AccessControl.has_access?(@current_user, owner_id, file_id)
      halt 403, JSON.generate({error: 'Access denied'})
    end

    content = Storage.get_file(owner_id, file_id)
    halt 404, JSON.generate({error: 'Not found'}) unless content
    content_type 'application/octet-stream'
    content
  end

  post '/share' do
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue {}
    file_id = payload['file_id']
    target_user = payload['target_user']

    halt 400, JSON.generate({error: 'Missing parameters'}) unless file_id && target_user

    # Verify the current user owns the file
    unless Storage.list_files(@current_user).include?(Storage.sanitize_filename(file_id))
      halt 404, JSON.generate({error: 'File not found in your uploads'})
    end

    AccessControl.grant_access(@current_user, file_id, target_user)
    JSON.generate({status: 'shared', file_id: file_id, shared_with: target_user})
  end
end
